set.body:
Objective: replace the dual-layer multivar implementation with one typed language for constructing statistical operators from related data spaces, compressing them through latent functional frames, and optimizing scalar functionals of the compressed operators.

Canonical chain:
L_st -> S_st = X_s* L_st X_t -> G_st = W_s* S_st W_t.

The constitution and multivar-ir baseline are already durable in HEAD. This epic is the finite core migration and release program.

Binding architecture:
- nominal spaces and explicit primal/dual ports;
- Op[From, To, Role, Evidence], with roles separate from certified claims;
- algebraic dual distinct from metric adjoint;
- secondOrder and compress as canonical typed constructions;
- FunctionalFrame W: K -> C* as the universal latent parameter, with scores and axes derived;
- one OperatorProgram with a closed BaseObjective ADT and first-class result semantics;
- named GPCA, LDA, CCA, PLS, RRR, and multiset builders compile to that program;
- compatibility adapters may delegate during migration, but no parallel compute engine survives the purge.

Finite delivery order:
1. Freeze the architecture contract and complete the legacy-consumer inventory.
2. Implement Op, secondOrder, compress, FunctionalFrame, structure-preserving kernels, and differential laws.
3. Add OperatorProgram, closed objectives, result contracts, and the wire IR.
4. Rebase GPCA without deleting still-needed compatibility adapters.
5. Add LDA as the independent proof that row-relation pullback generalizes.
6. Migrate paired methods, multiset/direct-sum, CPCA, kernel/Nystrom, and multiblock/row-geometry/plans/fit artifacts.
7. Delete the legacy numeric mirror only after all consumers migrate.
8. Pass the independent-oracle, JVM/JS, IR, representation, dependency, and clean-HEAD release gate.

Explicit separation: the open-ended variational expansion for target expressions, functionals, feasible sets, parameterizations, operator policies, nonsmooth lowering, and fold-safe ModelSpec is a separate follow-on epic. It may build on this core but cannot block core closure.

Completion: the release-gate child is closed at one committed tip; all requested and lowered programs, rewrites, evidence changes, result equivalence, numerical certificates, provenance, and solver guarantees are inspectable; the repository contains one compute layer and no unowned legacy consumer.
set.title: EPIC: multivar typed operator-compression core
